title: Graduates of KLETC’s 360th Basic Training Class take oath of office
summary_en: U.S. Rep. Ron Estes addressed the graduates of the Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center on July 31 as they completed their 14-week basic training course.
title_cn: Graduates of KLETC’s 360th Basic Training Class take oath of office

title: Spencer Museum announces KU Common Work of Art for 2026-2027
summary_en: The Spencer Museum of Art at the University of Kansas has selected the painting “Winter Flight” by Kay WalkingStick as the KU Common Work of Art for the 2026-2027 academic year. The painting complements themes from the KU Reads book, “Orbital” by Samantha Harvey.
title_cn: Spencer Museum announces KU Common Work of Art for 2026-2027

title: Students lead community-minded service projects through KU Trailblazers Program
summary_en: The University of Kansas Center for Service Learning has received external funding to support the continuation of the CSL’s Trailblazers Mini-Grant and Cohort Program. The 2025-2026 cohort included more than 25 student Trailblazers across 16 projects focused on sustainability, youth development, health and more.
title_cn: Students lead community-minded service projects through KU Trailblazers Program

title: Research finds rhetoric around #MeToo often focused on punishment, not causes of violence
summary_en: Meggie Mapes, a communication studies researcher at the University of Kansas, has found in a new study that rhetoric around the #MeToo movement often focused on punishment and "carceral feminism" instead of causes of gender-based violence. The work shows how punishment is a common part of communication in society, the author argues.
title_cn: Research finds rhetoric around #MeToo often focused on punishment, not causes of violence
